Monthly Import of Copper in 2005‐2010 3 #### **Executive Summary** #### **Highlights of international copper market** The average price of LME cash month copper and three month copper in Q4 was US$ 8,719/t and US$ 8,618/t respectively, up by 20.4% and 18.7% Q‐o‐Q, while up by 31.2 ％ and 29.1 ％ y‐o‐y. The average price was US$ 7,449/t and US$ 7,550/t respectively for the whole year of 2010, up by 44.7 ％ and 46.0 ％ y‐o‐y. The open interest of copper at three major Exchanges increased in Q4 2010. The increase of LME copper open interest was very obvious. It reached 300 thousand lots in November and 314.6 thousand lots in December. #### **Global refined copper demand and consumption falls back in Q4** The global copper production kept stable in Q4, and the volume was 4.61 million tonnes, down by 1.1% Q/Q. During the same period, global copper consumption fell back to 4.55 million tonnes, down by 1.9% Q/Q. It is estimated the world copper output is 18.53 million ton in 2010, up by 2.5% y/y. Copper consumption was 18.49 million ton, up by 6.9% y/y. The supply and demand of world copper is basically balanced in 2010. Seen from the main copper production regions, the growth mainly came from China, Zambia and Japan, about 460kt, 85kt and 80kt, respectively. In addition, the output from Germany, Poland and South Korea increased slightly. However, output from the world second largest copper producer Chile dropped down. The USA and Australia also reduced the copper output. China still leads the growth of copper consumption. Some developed countries, like the USA, Japan and Germany, also contributed much to the consumption. Downstream user chose buy fewer stock at such high price. Domestic price broke historical high in line with LME price. Three month copper price at SHFE rose to 71,970 yuan/t on the last day of 2010. SHFE open interest rebounded to 186.6 thousand lots in December after a few months’ decrease. During the same time, Comex open interest increased to historical high at 167.3 thousand lots. Output of Chinese copper concentrate was 1.042Mt during the first eleven months of 2010, dramatically up by 18.4% y‐o‐y. Because rising price of copper stimulated production. Affected by copper price decreased sharply in Q4 2008 and partial mines reduced production even shut down, copper concentrate output in same period of last year decreased sharply. Refined copper output slightly increased to 1.178Mt, up by 3.0% q‐o‐q. In respect of overall situation throughout 2010, refined copper increased dramatically to 4.578Mt, up by 11% compared with 2009. Output of most domestic main copper used products increased quickly in the first eleven months of this year, especially air conditioner and refrigeration products, the growth rate was faster than that in the first three quarters. #### **Chinese Copper Price** #### **Copper price hits record high** International strikes and accidents affected copper output in 2010. Meanwhile, Chinese “12th Five‐Year Plan” shows a strong demand for copper in the next few years. Expectation of tight supply and launch of copper ETF jointly pushed copper price up. LME copper closed at US$ 9,660/t on the last day of 2010. #### **Sulfuric acid price rebounds** Chinese sulfuric acid price went stable in 2010. In the beginning of 2010, bad weather affected production and supported price. In the middle of the year, China levied special duty for fertilizer export. Thus sul

furic acid price lingered around at low level. After that the duty was lowered and large fertilizer export pushed the price up. The average sulfuric acid price was 409 yuan/t in 2010. In terms of the international sulfuric acid price, it was in a rising track during the year. By the end of December, Brazil sulfuric acid price was as high as 840 yuan/t. the average sulfuric acid price of Brazil was 742 yuan/t. In 2011, Chinese sulfuric acid market will be in surplus. Sulfuric acid output will increase substantially. China also carries out strict export controlling policy for resource products. Low Custom duty term for phosphate fertilizer export is reduced to 3 months. Sulfuric acid price will face great pressure in 2011. Export volume of phosphate fertilizer will determine trend of domestic sulfuric acid price. It is expected that Chinese copper concentrate (copper content) production capacity will reach 1.24Mt, 1.3Mt and 1.35Mt in 2010, 2011 and 2012 respectively. Chinese mining expansion projects since this year are as following: #### **Mining expansion projects** **Daye Nonferrous Metals Co., Ltd** ’s Tonglvshan Copper Mine’s expansion project was kicked off in June, 2010. It can add 8,000t/y of mined copper and prolong mine’s service life for 17 years. **Xinxin Mining Co., Ltd** ’s Huangshan Cu‐Ni Mine’s 4,000t/d project was kicked off in June, 2010. The mine locates in Hami City, Xinjiang with 84Mt of Cu‐Ni ore reserves, including 380kt of nickel content, 220kt of copper content and 32kt of cobalt content. The project with total investment of 1bln yuan will be commissioned by the end of September, 2011. **Jiangxi Copper** ’s Dexing Copper Mine has finished 7,500t/d expansion project by the end of June. Currently Dexing Copper Mine has mining capacity of 107.5kt/d. The 7,500t/d expansion project was invested in 360mln yuan and took 10 months to be commissioned. 9 The total project with 130kt/d capacity is expected to be finished completely in 2012 on schedule. Overall investment will reach 2.7bln yuan. After the whole project being commissioned, its mining capacity will grow to 130kt/d from current 100kt. Outputs newly added will include 41kt copper‐in‐concentrate, 61kg gold and 25t silver. **Chengmenshan Copper Mine** ’s stage 2 was kicked off in December, 2009. The stage 2 with investment of 500mln yuan will be constructed for 2 years,

and it can process 7000t/d of ores and produce 14.8kt/y of copper. 

**Jiangxi Yinshan Mining Co., Ltd** ’s 5,000t/d project with total investment of 500mln yuan kicked off in January, 2010. 

**Jiangxi Copper** ’s Yongping Copper Mine will finish transformation from underground into open pit project in March, 2010. 

Jiangxi Copper plans to produce 172kt of copper concentrate in 2010, with 5kt over the previous year. 

**Zinjin Mining Holdings Group Co., Ltd** ’s Zinjinshan Copper Mine will establish two mining plants which can process 10kt/d and 8,000t/d of ores respectively. And it will also establish a 45kt/d grinding system project. Zinjinshan Copper Mine with total investment of 500mln yuan will be commissioned in 2011. 

**Zinjinshan Copper Mine** is located in Shanghang County, Longyan City, Fujian Province. 

**Xinjiang Huajin Copper Co., Ltd** ’s Tuwu Copper Mine kicked off on February 25, 2010. Tuwu Copper Mine with total investment of 2bln yuan planned to be finished by two stages. The first stage is going to be commissioned in 2011 and it is designed to process 5,000t/d of ores. The second stage can process 10kt/d of ores. 

**Tibet Huatailong Mining Co., Ltd** ’s Jiama Copper Polymetallic Mine with total investment of 1.6bln yuan planned to be finished by two stages. The first stage has finished construction at present. It can process 6,000t/d of ores and produce 15ktpy of copper concentrate. 

**Jiama Copper Polymetallic Mine** is located in Mozhugongka County, Tibet. 

Heilongjiang **Duobaoshan Copper‐Molybdenum Mine** launched workshop construction in end‐May. Duobaoshan Mine is invested by Heilongjiang Duobaoshan Copper Co., Ltd. (Duobaoshan Copper) with a total investment of 3.0bln yuan and planned to be finished by two stages. The first stage is going to be commissioned in 2011. After that it will be capable of processing 25kt ores per day, and producing 117,648 t copper concentrates (25% Cu) and 1,401 t molybdenum concentrates (45% Mo) per year.  When the second stage being commissioned, 50kt ores can be processed per day, and outputs of copper concentrates (25% Cu) and molybdenum concentrates (45%) will reach 233,316t and 3,014 t respectively. 

**Duobaoshan Copper Mine** is located in north of Nenjiang County, Heihe City, Heilongjiang Province. The resources identified are 9.47% Cu for 1.78Mt of copper metal, 0.016% Mo for 57.4kt of molybdenum, 0.144g/t Au for 60.29t gold and 2.059g/t Ag for 777.08t of silver. 

**Duobaoshan Copper** is established in January 2006 with registered capital of 600mln yuan. 

10 

Its holding shareholder is Zijin Mining Group that owns 51% stock. Other shareholders are Heilongjiang Heilong Mining Co., Ltd. (37%owned), Heilongjiang Dilian Investment Co., Ltd (9% owned) and Harbin Baifu Investment Co., Ltd. (3%). 

#### **Latest Chinese mining projects overseas in 2010:** 

**Zijin Mining Group Co., Ltd** (Zinjin Mining) announced in May, 2010 that it would invest 1.16bln yuan to purchase shares

of Platmin with China‐Africa Development Fund (CAD Fund). 

－ Platmin owns 68% shares of Deziwa Cu‐Co Mine and E cailleC Cu‐Co Mine. Deziwa Cu‐Co － Mine owns 1.34Mtpy of copper content reserves and 131kt of cobalt content reserves. E cailleC Cu‐Co Mine is estimated to own 251kt of copper reserves and 13kt of cobalt reserves. According to research study report, the project with total investment of US$466mln can process 4.5Mtpy of ores, and it can produce 80ktpy of copper and 10ktpy of cobalt after it is commissioned. Its service life will be 20 years. 

**Chinalco** invested US$2.2bln into Toromocho Mine project in Peru, it is expected to be become Peru's largest copper mine. Chinalco invested US$860mln to purchase Peru CopperInc. (CUP) and the prospecting right of Toromocho Mine. Chinalco estimated the project will be commissioned in 2012 and it can produce 250kt of copper each year. In Nov. 2010, Chinalco announced the project might be postponed to Q2 2013. 

**Jinchuan Nonferrous Metals Group Limited** (JNMC) signed an agreement with Kazakhmys in April, 2010 to jointly deplore Aktogay Copper Mine in Kazakhstan. JNMC invested US$120mln in this project and owned 49% shares of the project. It is estimated that the project will produce 100ktpy of copper concentrate content and the service life will be 40 years. 

The project will be commissioned within 5 years at least. 

**Tongling Nonferrous Metals Group Holdings Co., Ltd** (TLYS) announced on May 31 that it spent C$4.27bln to purchase 96.9% shares of Corriente Resources Inc (Corriente) with China Railway Construction Co., Ltd (CRCC). 

Corriente is a Canadian‐based resource development and exploration company specializing in copper and copper‐gold opportunities. It owns 17 mineral rights of copper mine belt in Ecuador. The main capital of Corriente is the mineral rights of Mirador, Mirador Norte, San Carlos and Panantza Copper Mines. Total copper reserves of these four copper mines are 11.58Mt. After the project is commissioned, it can process 54Mtpy of ores and produce 0.8‐1Mtpy of copper concentrate (contains 0.25‐0.3Mt of copper content) 

**China Sci‐Tech Holdings Ltd** (China Sci‐Tech) plans to restart copper production at the Lady Annie Copper Mine in Australia in December 2010. 

China Sci‐Tech acquired the mine from Cape Lambert Resources Ltd. earlier this month for A$135 million. 

Lady Annie currently has sufficient reserves and resources for around 4.5 years of operation at 25,000 metric tons of copper per year. 

11 

Separately, the company also announced it has agreed to buy Canada‐listed Chariot Resources Ltd’s 70% stake in Peru's Marcona Copper Property and the Mina Justa project for HK$1.8bln (US$232mln). 

Mina Justa's copper resources support annual output of around 100,000 metric tons of copper. 

The project would be commissioned in 2013, China Sci‐Tech said. 

**State Grid Corporation of China** (SGCC) signed an agreement with Quadra Mining to develop a large‐scale copper d

eposit in Chile in March. 

According to the agreement signed with Quadra, SGCC and Quadra will invest US$900mln to establish a new jointly venture company for developing Sierra Gorda project in the north of Chile. 

As a part of the agreement, SGCC will purchase 9.9% shares of Quadra with 1.42 cad (1.48US$). 

Sierra Gorda is located in Atacama Desert in Chile. It owns 98Mt of ore reserves and its ore average grade contains 0.42% copper content, 0.027% molybdenum content and 0.069g/t gold. It is planned to produce 139ktpy of copper, 7.3ktpy of molybdenum and 36 ounces of gold. And its exploiting time will be 25 years. 

SGCC is the biggest copper consumer in the world. It mainly uses copper in wire and cable. 

SGCC announced on Dec. 22 that Lady Annie had produced 1kt refined copper since it was commissioned in Nov. 2010. 

**Xiangguang Copper Co., Ltd** (Xiangguang Copper), a copper smelting unit of chicken supplier Shandong Fengxiang Group is planning to acquire 15% stakes of Rocklands Copper Mine. Rocklands Copper Mine belongs to CuDeco. 

The Rocklands Mine, near Cloncurry, Queensland, will have a 10 year exploration time frame and an annual production capacity of 3 million tons. It is expected to generate about $960 million in revenue annually. 

Xiangguang Copper locates in the south of Shifo town, Yanggu County, Shandong Province, it is a large‐scale nonferrous smelter with a annul production of 400,000tons of cathode copper. 

Up to now, the two sides have not yet signed the agreement. In Q3 2010, the chairman of Xiangguang Copper sought new copper cooperation project in South America and Africa and Xiangguang Copper signed some prospecting rights in Zambia in Q4 2010. 

**China Nonferrous Metal Mining Group Co., Ltd** (CNMC) will construct Muliashi Copper Mine. The reserves of Muliashi Copper Mine are estimated to be exploited for 15‐25 years. The project will be commissioned in 2012 and it can produce 60ktpy of copper. 

12 

**The president of Jiangxi Copper Co., Ltd.** (JCCL) Mr. Liyihuang said that JCCL’s Afghan Aynak Copper Mine project would be commissioned in 2013‐14. The project will produce 190ktpy of metal in initial period. Afghan Aynak Copper Mine was developed jointly by China Metallurgical Group Corporation (MCC) and JCCL. MCC and JCCL hold 75% and 25% stakes of Afghan Aynak Copper Mine project. 

**Guangdong Rising Assets Management Co., Ltd.** (Guangdong Rising) and Ord River Resource (ORD.ASX) would establish a joint venture company, mainly engaged in prospecting and developing copper mine in Australia and pacific region. Guangdong Rising and ORD.ASX owns 51% and 49% shares of the new company respectively. Guangdong Rising was founded on December 30, 1999 by the approval of the government of Guangdong Province. It has a registration capital of 1 billion yuan. It mainly deals with the nonferrous metals industry, electronic information industry, hotel and tourism industry, engineering project and real estate construction
